patches.rationale: Two bugs: money.discounted treats percent as a fraction (100*(1-20) = -1900) instead of a percentage, and checkout.invoice_total applies tax to the original amount rather than the discounted subtotal. Fix both, preserving no-discount/no-tax behavior. Add a new regression test file (tests/test_regression.py) covering the literal example 100/20/10% = 88, percentage interpretation, tax-on-discounted-subtotal, and preservation of no-discount/no-tax semantics with exact types.

edits.old:
def discounted(amount, percent):
    return amount * (1 - percent)
edits.new:
def discounted(amount, percent):
    return amount * (1 - percent / 100)

contract_tests: tests/test_regression.py::test_result_types: discounted(100, 20) is int/float numeric and invoice_total(100, 20, 0.1) == 88 with type int
